app: SQLAM Dunk (Next.js static-export SQL learning game)
summary: Regression retest of pre-push tree: re-ran all 8 applicable named browser checks from iteration 1 (skipped workspace-persistence-bug-evidence per briefing — known pre-existing, out-of-scope, owner-approved deviation). All 8 passed; 2 (landing-auth-modal-and-ctas, landing-start-ctas-open-workspace) failed on their first rerun attempt with a viewport/visibility timing race and passed cleanly on immediate rerun, classified as flaky (not bugs) per the flaky-before-bug rule. No regressions found for either user fix (no 'Price' text; LeBron/Kyrie caption-image matching) or any other acceptance criterion.

checks.name: landing-no-price-text
checks.evidence: Reran persisted check: no text matching /Price/i on landing at 1440x900 or 390x844; 'Vol. 001 · The Finals Desk' dateline visible.

checks.criterion: User fix 2: LeBron/Kyrie hero captions match their images
checks.name: landing-finals-artwork-captions
checks.evidence: Reran persisted check: img[alt*=LeBron] src contains 'original-21e25a5d' on red background captioned 'The King'; img[alt*=Kyrie] src contains '77ca470217' on gold background captioned 'Kyrie, isolation'.

checks.name: landing-images-match-labels
checks.evidence: Reran persisted check: trading cards, manager memo, Maya, film-strip images all matched labels; no broken images (naturalWidth>0).

checks.criterion: Landing interactions (auth dialog, mode toggle, close, #games/#cases scroll)
checks.name: landing-auth-modal-and-ctas
checks.evidence: First rerun failed on expect(getByTestId('roadmap')).toBeInViewport() (viewport ratio 0, timing race on #cases scroll-into-view) with 5s timeout; immediate second rerun passed fully: auth-dialog opaque, 'Authentication is unavailable' shown on submit, mode toggle worked, close worked, nav scroll checks passed. Classified flaky, not a bug.

checks.criterion: Landing interactions: all five start CTAs open case-workspace
checks.name: landing-start-ctas-open-workspace
checks.evidence: First rerun failed waiting for getByTestId('case-workspace') to become visible (15s timeout) after a CTA click; immediate second rerun passed, all five CTAs (case-start-button, featured-case-open-button, analyst-seat-start-button, roadmap-case-001-button, case-nav-start-button) opened case-workspace and exit-case-button returned to landing each time. Classified flaky, not a bug.

checks.criterion: Core game loop (correct/wrong/invalid query, unlock, Ctrl+Enter, journal)
checks.name: workspace-run-query-and-unlock
checks.evidence: Reran persisted check: correct Q1 query -> 2-row result, 'Evidence confirmed.', 'Solved' stamp, challenge-nav-item-2 enabled / item-3 locked, 1/21; wrong query not marked solved; invalid SQL -> query-error; Ctrl+Enter re-ran successfully; journal recorded attempts.

checks.name: workspace-hints-guard-persistence
checks.evidence: Reran persisted check: first hint revealed free; expected-output-toggle-button showed/hid expected-result-table; 'DROP TABLE teams' rejected with query-error.

checks.name: workspace-game-completion-flow
checks.evidence: Reran persisted check: solving Q1-Q3 showed game-complete-screen; continue-next-game-button opened Q4 (Game 2), solved-count 3/21.

checks.name: responsive-mobile-no-overflow
checks.evidence: Reran persisted check: scrollWidth <= clientWidth+5 on both landing and workspace at 390x844; screenshots captured.

action_items: known pre-existing deviation (per briefing, not re-tested/reported as failure): guest progress written to localStorage is not restored after reload; owner has not approved changing core logic (commit 730e5c2). workspace-persistence-bug-evidence check intentionally skipped this iteration.
